cohort: The study included 2,714 postpartum mothers who received services from a tertiary hospital-affiliated breastfeeding support center in Sanliurfa, Turkiye.
finding: Contraceptive users had significantly longer average durations of breastfeeding for both previous first-born infants (16.68 months vs. 11.16 months) and all surviving children (18.82 months vs. 13.05 months) compared to non-users.
followup_time: Up to 18.82 months (based on the maximum average duration of breastfeeding observed)
